item.title: NAHREP’s new president targets credit, supply — and rising fear
item.description: Acevedo's agenda, he said, begins with tackling two fundamental challenges: housing inventory and access to credit.

item.title: NAR RPAC disbursed $10.02M as 2026 elections near
item.description: FEC filings show NAR’s RPAC disbursed $10.02M from Jan. 2025 to Feb. 2026, including $1.27M to candidates and $1.58 in operating expenses.

item.title: A modular player scales in urban high-rise apartment projects
item.description: VBC says its steel modular system supports towers up to 35 stories, targeting high cost urban infill markets and labor gaps.

item.title: Gen X most worried about taxes, volatility and inflation before retirement
item.description: Allianz Q1 2026 survey shows 70% of Americans fear retirement taxes, with Gen X leading concerns about volatility and inflation.

item.title: Mortgage rates rise as Treasury yields hit 8-month high
item.description: The 30-year fixed rate hit 6.49% at MND, up 13 bps weekly, while HousingWire Data showed a 6.28% average for conforming loans.

item.title: HUD investigates Washington covenant homeownership program
item.description: HUD opened a Fair Housing Act probe into Washington’s Covenant Homeownership Program over eligibility tied to race and ancestry.

item.title: Why modular construction fits high-cost custom markets
item.description: Plant Prefab says modular and panelized methods cut build time 25% to 50% and reduce waste about 40% per square foot.

item.title: Howard Hanna settles Tuccori homebuyer commission case
item.description: Howard Hanna parent Hanna Holdings opted into Tuccori’s settlement as Batton plaintiffs move to block opt-in deals and coordination.

item.title: California MBA urges guardrails for bill on wildfire forbearance
item.description: CMBA told lawmakers that AB 238 aids short-term relief, but insurance delays and permitting backlogs are stalling wildfire recovery.

item.title: How mentorship, not recruiting alone, builds strong loan officers
item.description: Mortgage companies that invest in mentorship, structure and real-world development are better positioned to build confident loan officers, reduce churn and create durable production.

item.title: HighTechLending, Better partner to expand EquitySelect HELOC
item.description: Better’s NEO Home Loans will offer HighTechLending’s EquitySelect HELOC, targeting borrowers with strong credit facing DTI limits.

item.title: Applications fall 10.5% as 30-year fixed rate moves higher
item.description: MBA’s weekly survey for the week ending March 20, 2026 shows applications fell 10.5% as the 30-year fixed increased to 6.43%.

item.title: Yellow pad math can explain a lot about homebuilder decisions
item.description: Lot and direct cost mix can shift risk, velocity incentives, and IRR, explaining why builder strategies differ dramatically by market.

item.title: UWM rolls out mortgage payment rewards via Bilt platform
item.description: UWM launched Built-In Rewards, letting borrowers earn points via Bilt for on-time digital payments as servicing moves in-house.

item.title: States bet on by-right housing projects on church land
item.description: Virginia, Florida and California expanded by-right housing on church land, targeting affordability and faster approvals for surplus sites.
